<script lang="ts">
	import type { GroupActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: GroupActionProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Icon button at the end of the group label; give it an aria-label. -->
<button type="button" class={["sidebarGroupAction", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</button>

<style>
	/* Base action; lines up with the label */
	.sidebarGroupAction {
		display: flex;
		position: absolute;
		top: calc(var(--spacing-md) + 2px);
		right: var(--spacing-md);
		justify-content: center;
		align-items: center;
		transition-duration: 150ms;
		transition-property: color, background-color, box-shadow;
		transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
		cursor: pointer;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
		background-color: transparent;
		padding: 0;
		width: 1.25rem; /* 20px */
		height: 1.25rem; /* 20px */
		color: var(--sidebar-foreground);
	}

	.sidebarGroupAction:hover {
		background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
		color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
	}

	.sidebarGroupAction:focus-visible {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
	}

	.sidebarGroupAction :global(svg) {
		flex-shrink: 0;
		width: 1rem; /* 16px */
		height: 1rem; /* 16px */
	}

	/* Collapsed to icons, the action hides with its label */
	:global(.sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"]) .sidebarGroupAction {
		display: none;
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { GroupLabelProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: GroupLabelProps = $props();
	// A label that runs something on press is a button, such as the trigger of a collapsible group.
	const isButton = $derived(props.onclick !== undefined);
</script>

<!-- Muted heading of the group; fades out while collapsed to icons. -->
<svelte:element this={isButton ? "button" : "div"} type={isButton ? "button" : undefined} class={["sidebarGroupLabel", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</svelte:element>

<style>
	/* Base label */
	.sidebarGroupLabel {
		display: flex;
		flex-shrink: 0;
		align-items: center;
		transition-duration: 200ms;
		transition-property: margin, opacity;
		transition-timing-function: linear;
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
		padding-inline: var(--spacing-sm);
		height: var(--control-height-sm);
		color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--sidebar-foreground) 70%, transparent);
		font-weight: 500;
		font-size: var(--text-xs);
		line-height: var(--line-height-xs);
	}

	.sidebarGroupLabel :global(svg) {
		flex-shrink: 0;
		width: 1rem; /* 16px */
		height: 1rem; /* 16px */
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* A button label fills the group width and highlights on hover */
	button.sidebarGroupLabel {
		cursor: pointer;
		box-sizing: border-box;
		width: 100%;
		text-align: left;
	}

	button.sidebarGroupLabel:hover {
		background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
		color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
	}

	/* Keyboard focus ring */
	button.sidebarGroupLabel:focus-visible {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
	}

	/* Collapsed to icons, the label slides up out of view */
	:global(.sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"]) .sidebarGroupLabel {
		opacity: 0;
		margin-top: calc(var(--control-height-sm) * -1);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Input } from "#lib/components/ui/input/index.js";
	import type { SidebarInputProps } from "./index.js";
	let { value = $bindable(), ...props }: SidebarInputProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Compact input, such as a search field, on the page background. -->
<Input size="sm" style="background-color: var(--background); box-shadow: none" bind:value {...props} />

<script lang="ts">
	import type { InsetProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: InsetProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Main content beside the sidebar. -->
<main class={["sidebarInset", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</main>

<style>
	/* Base inset; takes the room beside the sidebar */
	.sidebarInset {
		display: flex;
		position: relative;
		flex: 1;
		flex-direction: column;
		background-color: var(--background);
		width: 100%;
		min-width: 0;
	}

	/* Beside an inset sidebar, the content is a rounded frame */
	@media (min-width: 48rem) {
		:global(.sidebarWrapper:has(> .sidebar[data-variant="inset"])) > .sidebarInset {
			border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
		}
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { MenuActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { showOnHover = false, children, class: className, ...props }: MenuActionProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Icon button at the end of the menu item, such as a "more" menu; give it an aria-label. -->
<button type="button" class={["sidebarMenuAction", className]} data-show-on-hover={showOnHover || undefined} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</button>

<style>
	/* Base action; centered on the button's end */
	.sidebarMenuAction {
		display: flex;
		position: absolute;
		top: calc(var(--spacing-xs) + 2px);
		right: var(--spacing-xs);
		justify-content: center;
		align-items: center;
		transition-duration: 150ms;
		transition-property: color, background-color, box-shadow, opacity;
		transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
		cursor: pointer;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
		background-color: transparent;
		padding: 0;
		width: 1.25rem; /* 20px */
		height: 1.25rem; /* 20px */
		color: var(--sidebar-foreground);
	}

	.sidebarMenuAction:hover {
		background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
		color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
	}

	.sidebarMenuAction :global(svg) {
		flex-shrink: 0;
		width: 1rem; /* 16px */
		height: 1rem; /* 16px */
	}

	/* Hidden until the item is hovered or focused, or its menu is open; also inside a `Collapsible` that wraps the item's parts */
	.sidebarMenuAction[data-show-on-hover] {
		opacity: 0;
	}

	:global(.sidebarMenuItem:hover) > .sidebarMenuAction[data-show-on-hover],
	:global(.sidebarMenuItem:focus-within) > .sidebarMenuAction[data-show-on-hover],
	:global(.sidebarMenuItem:hover > .collapsible) > .sidebarMenuAction[data-show-on-hover],
	:global(.sidebarMenuItem:focus-within > .collapsible) > .sidebarMenuAction[data-show-on-hover],
	.sidebarMenuAction[data-show-on-hover][data-state="open"] {
		opacity: 1;
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Keyboard focus ring */
	.sidebarMenuAction:focus-visible {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
	}

	/* Collapsed to icons, the action hides */
	:global(.sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"]) .sidebarMenuAction {
		display: none;
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, type TooltipTriggerProps } from "#lib/components/ui/tooltip/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { MenuButtonProps } from "./index.js";
	const { isActive = false, variant = "default", size = "md", tooltip, showTooltip = false, href, children, class: className, ...props }: MenuButtonProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const isLink = $derived(href !== undefined);
	// The tooltip shows the label while the sidebar is collapsed to its icons, or always with `showTooltip`.
	const showsTooltip = $derived(!!tooltip && (showTooltip || ctx.isIconCollapsed));
</script>

<!-- The button itself; extra attributes come from the tooltip trigger when it wraps the button. -->
{#snippet menuButton(tooltipAttrs?: Parameters<NonNullable<TooltipTriggerProps["trigger"]>>[0]["props"])}
	<svelte:element this={isLink ? "a" : "button"} type={isLink ? undefined : "button"} class={["sidebarMenuButton", className]} {href} aria-current={isActive && isLink ? "page" : undefined} data-active={isActive || undefined} data-variant={variant} data-size={size} {...tooltipAttrs} {...props}>
		{@render children()}
	</svelte:element>
{/snippet}

{#if showsTooltip}
	<!-- Collapsed to icons: the label shows in a tooltip beside the button. -->
	<Tooltip side={ctx.side === "left" ? "right" : "left"} arrow={false}>
		<TooltipTrigger>
			{#snippet trigger({ props: tooltipAttrs })}
				{@render menuButton(tooltipAttrs)}
			{/snippet}
		</TooltipTrigger>
		<TooltipContent>{tooltip}</TooltipContent>
	</Tooltip>
{:else}
	{@render menuButton()}
{/if}

<style>
	/* Base button; the last span is the label and truncates */
	.sidebarMenuButton {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		transition-duration: 150ms;
		transition-property: width, height, padding, color, background-color, box-shadow;
		transition-timing-function: linear;
		cursor: pointer;
		box-sizing: border-box;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
		background-color: transparent;
		padding: var(--spacing-sm);
		width: 100%;
		overflow: hidden;
		color: var(--sidebar-foreground);
		font: inherit;
		text-align: left;
		text-decoration: none;
	}

	.sidebarMenuButton:hover,
	.sidebarMenuButton:active {
		background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
		color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
	}

	.sidebarMenuButton > :global(span:last-child) {
		overflow: hidden;
		text-overflow: ellipsis;
		white-space: nowrap;
	}

	.sidebarMenuButton > :global(svg) {
		flex-shrink: 0;
		width: 1rem; /* 16px */
		height: 1rem; /* 16px */
	}

	/* =============== Variants =============== */

	/* Bordered button on the page background */
	.sidebarMenuButton[data-variant="outline"] {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sidebar-border);
		background-color: var(--background);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Current page */
	.sidebarMenuButton[data-active] {
		background-color: var(--sidebar-accent);
		color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground);
		font-weight: 500;
	}

	/* Keyboard focus ring */
	.sidebarMenuButton:focus-visible {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--sidebar-ring);
	}

	/* Disabled state for buttons and links */
	.sidebarMenuButton:disabled,
	.sidebarMenuButton[aria-disabled="true"] {
		opacity: 50%;
		pointer-events: none;
	}

	/* =============== Sizes =============== */

	/* Large; room for two lines, such as a name and an email */
	.sidebarMenuButton[data-size="lg"] {
		height: 3rem; /* 48px */
		font-size: var(--text-sm);
	}

	/* Medium — default */
	.sidebarMenuButton[data-size="md"] {
		height: var(--control-height-sm);
		font-size: var(--text-sm);
	}

	/* Small */
	.sidebarMenuButton[data-size="sm"] {
		height: 1.75rem; /* 28px */
		font-size: var(--text-xs);
	}

	/* Extra small */
	.sidebarMenuButton[data-size="xs"] {
		height: var(--control-height-xs);
		font-size: var(--text-xs);
	}

	/* Collapsed to icons, every button is a square that shows only its icon */
	:global(.sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"]) .sidebarMenuButton {
		padding: var(--spacing-sm);
		width: var(--control-height-sm);
		height: var(--control-height-sm);
	}

	:global(.sidebar[data-collapsible="icon"]) .sidebarMenuButton[data-size="lg"] {
		padding: 0;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { RailProps } from "./index.js";
	const { onclick, class: className, ...props }: RailProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();

	/** Toggles the sidebar, unless a passed click handler prevented the default. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		// If the passed handler called preventDefault: leave the sidebar as it is.
		if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
		ctx.toggle();
	};
</script>

<!-- Strip on the sidebar edge; mouse only, since the trigger and the shortcut cover the keyboard. -->
<button type="button" class={["sidebarRail", className]} aria-label="Toggle sidebar" tabindex="-1" title="Toggle sidebar" data-side={ctx.side} data-state={ctx.state} onclick={handleClick} {...props}></button>

<style>
	/* Base rail; straddles the sidebar edge */
	.sidebarRail {
		display: none;
		position: absolute;
		z-index: 20;
		transition: background-color 150ms linear;
		inset-block: 0;
		border: 0;
		background-color: transparent;
		padding: 0;
		width: 1rem; /* 16px hit area */
	}

	@media (min-width: 40rem) {
		.sidebarRail {
			display: flex;
		}
	}

	/* Hairline that shows on hover */
	.sidebarRail::after {
		position: absolute;
		inset-block: 0;
		left: 50%;
		transition: background-color 150ms linear;
		width: 2px;
		content: "";
	}

	.sidebarRail:hover::after {
		background-color: var(--sidebar-border);
	}

	.sidebarRail[data-side="left"] {
		right: -0.5rem;
		cursor: w-resize;
	}

	.sidebarRail[data-side="right"] {
		left: -0.5rem;
		cursor: e-resize;
	}

	/* The cursor points the way the sidebar will move */
	.sidebarRail[data-side="left"][data-state="collapsed"] {
		cursor: e-resize;
	}

	.sidebarRail[data-side="right"][data-state="collapsed"] {
		cursor: w-resize;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { PanelLeftIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TriggerProps, TriggerAttrs } from "./index.js";
	const { trigger, onclick, ...props }: TriggerProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const triggerProps: TriggerAttrs = $derived({
		"aria-label": "Toggle sidebar",
		"aria-expanded": ctx.isMobile ? ctx.openMobile : ctx.open,
		onclick: () => ctx.toggle(),
	});

	/** Toggles the sidebar, unless a passed click handler prevented the default. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		// If the passed handler called preventDefault: leave the sidebar as it is.
		if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
		ctx.toggle();
	};
</script>

<!-- Render the custom trigger when given, otherwise a ghost icon button that expands and collapses the sidebar, or opens the drawer on mobile. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" {...triggerProps} {...props} onclick={handleClick}>
		<PanelLeftIcon />
	</Button>
{/if}

description: A collapsible app sidebar with groups, menus, sub menus, and icon mode, that becomes a drawer on mobile.
